mechanism: Sulfasalazine inhibits bacterial vitamin K synthesis in the colon by suppressing gut flora, reducing vitamin K production and potentially diminishing anticoagulant reversal efficacy or increasing bleeding risk in vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis.
action: Monitor vitamin K status and prothrombin time in patients on concurrent therapy, particularly those receiving warfarin; consider vitamin K supplementation or monitoring if prolonged sulfasalazine use is anticipated.
